children: Shares of speciality chemicals manufacturer Prasol Chemicals hit the upper circuit limit of 10 per cent on the debut day on Wednesday after listing at a discount to the issue price.
The stock settled at Rs 671 per share on the NSE.
Shares of Prasol Chemicals listed at Rs 611 on the BSE, down 9.61 per cent from the issue price of Rs 676.
Meanwhile, shares of transformer manufacturer Kanohar Electricals settled at Rs 751.50 per share on the NSE, up 19.30 per cent from its issue price.
The stock gained 10 per cent from its debut price.
Kanohar Electricals listed at Rs 672.05 on the BSE, up 6.33 per cent from the issue price of Rs 632.
At the NSE, the stock made its market debut at Rs 685.50, a premium of 8.46 per cent over the issue price.
Shares of facade solutions provider Glass Wall Systems (India) also extended gains on the debut day to settle at Rs 214.85 per share on the NSE, up 18.68 per cent from its issue price.
The stock gained 11.34 per cent from its debut price.
Glass Wall Systems (India) shares listed at Rs 190.10 on the BSE, up 4.45 per cent from the issue price of Rs 182.
At the NSE, the stock started trading at Rs 194, registering a gain of 6.59 per cent.

title: Prasol Chemicals hits upper circuit post 10% discount listing; Glass Wall Systems, Kanohar Electricals extend gains
